title: %formatDuration — human-readable duration
purpose: Render a duration in seconds (or ISO 8601) as English components.
expectedOutput:
{out}
s = "1 day, 1 hour, 1 minute, 1 second"
iso = "2 hours, 30 minutes"
oneHour = "1 hour"
seconds = "45 seconds"
notes: A numeric input is treated as seconds and expanded into days, hours, minutes, and seconds.
An ISO 8601 duration string such as "PT2H30M" is also accepted; zero components are omitted.
